I count 4 genuinely new cells across the three motifs beyond the orbit union, bringing the total nonzero count to 40, and the row-by-row tallies in the output confirm that exactly. With this verified, I'm ready to move on to the test input.

- All other ray cells (including the start) keep the original color.
